reviews.title: Basically a Calculator
reviews.text: This app just takes the average mpg of your car, the distance of your trip, and divides. Would be useful if it helped plan fuel stops for cost efficiency. This app is not really worth more than a google search.

reviews.title: Pretty worthless if it doesnt update the prices
reviews.text: With current prices through the roof decided to try the app out, but its completely useless as its showing prices that are at least 2 weeks - maybe more - out of date. I wish i could still get diesel for 137p a litre!!! (Currently over 160)

reviews.title: Don’t bother
reviews.text: Not even close to accurate. Says a 30 mile trip will cost me $10 in gas. Can’t adjust the price of gas and it’s not even close to correct in its estimate.  Deleting right after this review.
